text:
Sara Li: :rotating_light: seeing elevated 5xx rate from eu-west2 customers beginning ~08:02 UTC. Several support tickets from AcmeMaps and two other customers. Dashboard shows spike in gateway 502/504s and auth retries.

Juan Perez: Can you paste the query? need request ids to correlate logs.

Sara Li: Query: `sum(rate(gateway_5xx_total{region="eu-west2"}[1m])) by (az)` shows 5x baseline in az-eu2-b. Logs show lots of `upstream reset` and `tls handshake errors`.

InfraBot: deploy 1782345599 to edge-lb-eu-west2-b completed at 08:07 UTC (no errors)

Alex Kim: CS provided a repro curl from AcmeMaps:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -d '{"model":"rwd/llamax-13b","prompt":"hi"}'
# -> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
# x-request-id: rwd-eu-01-3a9c
```

Net Ops: We're seeing egress path packet loss and retransmits toward ASN 64512 (provider A). BGP updates show flap around 08:01 UTC causing asymmetric routing. tcpdump from edge-eu2-b shows duplicate acks and packet reorder.

Net Ops: Short-term mitigation: divert traffic from peer A -> peer B via route preference (applied). Opening ticket -> provider AS64512 (ticket 987654). Also scheduling scrubbing via intermediate provider C.

Mike O'Connor: CS Ops, please notify AcmeMaps + offer 24h credit and status link. Also collect their request-ids. @CS Ops

CS Ops: Notifying now, collecting request ids. We asked for a repro sample and extended logs. Sending interim statement: "We are experiencing egress provider instability affecting eu-west2; engineering is actively mitigating."

Eng Oncall: Recommend enabling fallback model variant (rwd/llamax-13b-q4) for hosted inference in eu-west2 to reduce session time and lower chance of upstream timeouts. Will push config toggle to canary traffic (5%) to avoid regressions.

Sara Li: After route change we saw 70% reduction in 5xx within 12min. Still seeing auth retries for a subset — looks like some clients retried with stale connections.

Alex Kim: Action items: (1) Net Ops to confirm provider ticket and ETA (2) Eng Oncall to roll fallback config + watch latencies (3) CS Ops to compile affected request-ids and issue credits (4) Postmortem owner: Sara Li. I'll create incident doc and link.

Net Ops: Provider ACKed ticket, investigating BGP flap cause. ETA next update 09:00 UTC.

CS Ops: Message sent to AcmeMaps, they confirmed reduced errors after ~08:20 UTC. They'll share logs if anything else.

Sara Li: Good work. Will keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
